text: Drake Maye's breakout Week 5 performance—which earned him FedEx Air & Ground Player of the Week honors alongside Jordan Love—has given the Patriots genuine momentum heading into Sunday's 1 PM ET matchup against the Jets at Gillette Stadium, though the injury report threatens to complicate matters considerably: left tackle Will Campbell is sidelined with an MCL sprain in his right knee and expected to miss game action, running back TreVeyon Henderson faces multiple weeks out with a high ankle sprain, but there's some encouraging news on the secondary as cornerback Christian Gonzalez said Wednesday he's "ready to go" after missing the past two games with a shoulder injury, and wide receiver Brown has returned to practice. With Maye apparently having found his confidence and his deep ball after a rocky start to the season, the Patriots are one of ESPN's recommended survivor pool picks for Week 6 alongside the Rams and Colts—though keeping the young quarterback upright without Campbell at left tackle will be critical to sustaining this newfound offensive rhythm.
